platform_message: RolloutAborted: Rollout aborted update to revision 46: Background analysis phase error/failed: Metric "latency-p95" assessed Failed due to failed (2) > failureLimit (1)
summary: order-api errors (injected 500s) during revision 44 rollout from 07:06 caused analysis failure and abort at 07:07. Revision 46 redeployed at 07:12 and is paused and unhealthy, but 5xx and p95 are currently normal.
cause: A config change to the order-api faults config (revision 44) injected HTTP 500 responses from 07:06, which failed the error-rate analysis and aborted the rollout. The later revision 46 redeploy with another faults config is now paused and unhealthy.
